name: scenelith
description: Open visual AI creation and automation canvas with first-class self-hosting

scripts.selfhost:pull:infrastructure: docker compose --env-file deploy/selfhost/.env -f deploy/selfhost/compose.yaml pull postgres redis gateway
scripts.selfhost:build: docker compose --env-file deploy/selfhost/.env -f deploy/selfhost/compose.yaml build frameflow
scripts.selfhost:up:source: npm run selfhost:doctor && npm run selfhost:pull:infrastructure && npm run selfhost:build && docker compose --env-file deploy/selfhost/.env -f deploy/selfhost/compose.yaml up -d --no-build --pull never
